remarks: Beachside Bliss - A One-Bedroom Ranch in Shippan Embrace the ease of single-floor living with this exquisitely renovated one-bedroom ranch, nestled in the coveted Shippan neighborhood of Stamford. A perfect condo alternative, this home offers a blend of luxury and convenience, just two blocks from the beach. Step into a home that's been completely transformed in 2023. The heart of the residence, a chef's kitchen, boasts brand-new cabinetry, a prestigious Lacornue range, and top-of-the-line appliances. The bathroom is a sanctuary of modern comfort, featuring heated floors, a Toto toilet, and stylish fixtures. Comfort extends into the spacious walk-in closet, while the new furnace and Central A/C ensures your home is a haven of warmth and cooling. Outside, two patios provide serene spots for relaxation or entertaining, with two off-street parking spaces included. Enjoy the tranquility of Shippan, with its proximity to the water and all the amenities Stamford has to offer. Don't miss the opportunity to own this turn-key gem, where every day feels like a vacation. Like new construction!   We are going to Highest and Best by Monday 12/16/24 at 6:00pm
